parent_objective: run short source-diverse protected PPO escalation from M333 base with exact repair and bounded first proof gates

public_gates: exact M297 and exact M270 no-regression versus M333 after repair
old 9944 margin gap remains at least 0.09 or bounded interpolation selects an alpha that does
M183/M170 first replay gate versus M333
M267/M264 first replay gate versus M333
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip source-diverse protected gates
do not lower the old-key gap floor
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: A 4096-step short PPO escalation from the M333 source-diverse public base can provide useful proposal movement while retaining exact objectives, source-diverse protected proof, old-key gap floor, and first replay gates after exact repair or bounded interpolation.
success_criteria: raw PPO completes and writes checkpoint
selected candidate does not regress exact M297 or exact M270 versus M333
old 9944 margin gap is reported and remains at least 0.09 for the selected candidate
M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates pass
failure_criteria: exact repair fails or exact objectives regress
no endpoint or bounded interpolation candidate keeps old-key margin gap >= 0.09

commands.name: m335_short_ppo
commands.command: Run 4096-step PPO from M333 base using configs/ppo_m335_short_source_diverse_escalation.json.

commands.name: m335_exact_repair
commands.command: Run exact_post_ppo_repair from the raw PPO proposal with M333 base.

commands.name: m335_source_diverse_old_key_and_first_gates
commands.command: Run source-diverse protected gate, old-key gap-floor diagnostic or bounded interpolation, and M183/M170 plus M267/M264 first replay gates.

decision_rule: M335 may only admit a full public gate if a selected repaired or bounded-interpolation candidate passes exact objectives, source-diverse protected gates, old-key margin-gap floor, and first replay gates. M335 itself cannot promote.
